```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
 
# ---- 1. Donors to keep ------------------------------------------------------
included <- trimws(as.character(unique(no_cutoff_data$Donor)))
 
# ---- 2. Filter each dataset to the included donors --------------------------
# Match the key type/format on both sides before filtering (your Donor column is
# character because of the HPAP### IDs, so case_id must be character too).
prep <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(case_id = trimws(as.character(case_id))) %>%
    filter(case_id %in% included)
}
 
nd  <- prep(ND)
t1d <- prep(T1D)
 
# ---- Sanity checks (read these before trusting the table) -------------------
matched <- c(nd$case_id, t1d$case_id)
missing <- setdiff(included, matched)
if (length(missing))
  warning("Included donors not found in ND or T1D: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
 
dupe <- intersect(nd$case_id, t1d$case_id)
if (length(dupe))
  warning("Donors appearing in BOTH groups: ", paste(dupe, collapse = ", "))
 
cat("ND n =", nrow(nd), " | T1D n =", nrow(t1d),
    " | total =", nrow(nd) + nrow(t1d), "\n")
 
# Confirm category labels match what the table expects (spelling/case matters):
print(table(c(nd$gender,    t1d$gender)))
print(table(c(nd$ethnicity, t1d$ethnicity)))
 
# ---- 3. Helper summaries ----------------------------------------------------
# "mean +/- SD" to 4 significant figures, matching the original table's style.
msd <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  sprintf("%s \u00B1 %s",
          signif(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          signif(sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE), 4))
}
# case-insensitive category count within a column
cnt <- function(df, col, value)
  sum(trimws(tolower(df[[col]])) == tolower(value), na.rm = TRUE)
 
# ---- 4. Build the column values ---------------------------------------------
ethnicities <- c("African American", "Native American", "Asian",
                 "Caucasian", "Hispanic", "Multiracial")
 
make_col <- function(df) {
  c(N                = nrow(df),
    Age              = msd(df$age_yrs),
    Sex              = "",
    Female           = cnt(df, "gender", "Female"),
    Male             = cnt(df, "gender", "Male"),
    `Race/Ethnicity` = "",
    setNames(sapply(ethnicities, function(e) cnt(df, "ethnicity", e)), ethnicities),
    HbA1c            = msd(df$hb_a1c),
    BMI              = msd(df$bmi))
}
 
nd_col  <- make_col(nd)
t1d_col <- make_col(t1d)
 
tab <- data.frame(
  Diagnosis = names(nd_col),
  ND        = unname(nd_col),
  T1D       = unname(t1d_col),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
 
print(tab)   # <-- inspect the numbers before writing the file

included <- trimws(as.character(unique(no_cutoff_data$Donor)))
setdiff(included, c(nd$case_id, t1d$case_id))

all_ids <- trimws(as.character(c(ND$case_id, T1D$case_id)))
setdiff(included, all_ids)   # truly not present anywhere

miss <- setdiff(included, c(nd$case_id, t1d$case_id))

# show any raw case_id that resembles a missing one
lapply(miss, function(m)
  grep(m, all_ids, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE))

sum(is.na(no_cutoff_data$Donor))
length(included)   # should be 106; if it's 104, the loss is upstream
```

```{r}
# ---- 5. Write the corrected Word table --------------------------------------
ft <- flextable(tab) |>
  bold(i = which(tab$Diagnosis %in% c("Sex", "Race/Ethnicity")), j = 1) |>
  align(j = 2:3, align = "center", part = "all") |>
  autofit()
 
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("Table 1: Subject demographics.", style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_flextable(ft)
 
print(doc, target = "Table_1_fixed.docx")
cat("Wrote Table_1_fixed.docx to:", getwd(), "\n")
```
